subject: [Customer update] SEV-2 impacting embeddings - snapshot & commitments
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SEV-2 / GreenLane embeddings - prep customer update

Folks — quick heads-up. We've confirmed a SEV-2 impacting embedding similarity results for a subset of GreenLane's prod index (eu-west models routed through our US pool). Initial metrics: ~8% uplift in distance metric for queries with >512 tokens, correlated with a kernel fallback that started after a failed quantized kernel load on two GPU hosts.

Impact: GreenLane reported increased retrieval misses for late-night batch jobs. They see spikes primarily for queries with long context (>512).

Immediate asks:
- Ben: draft a concise customer-facing snapshot (~3 bullets + ETA) that we can send within 30 minutes.
- Grace: coordinate with runtime to confirm mitigation ETA and whether we can route GreenLane to the warmed fallback pool for short term.
- Monica: prepare the impact matrix (customers affected, failed kernel hosts, start/stop times) — attach CSV.

I am available to send the external update after a short review. Keep replies inline and short.

[Attachment: greenlane_impact_matrix.csv] 

Thanks,
Sofia
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SEV-2 / GreenLane embeddings - prep customer update

Sofia — draft below. Kept it short for exec consumption.

--- DRAFT (Customer-facing) ---
From: Sofia Ivanova, Director, Customer Reliability (Redwood Inference)
To: Oliver Reed, GreenLane AI; support@greenlane.ai
Subject: Brief update: service disruption affecting embedding similarity (SEV-2)

Hi Oliver —

We’re reaching out with a quick status snapshot. Earlier today we detected a degradation in embedding similarity scores affecting a portion of your production index. Impact is focused on queries with longer context (>512 tokens).

What happened: One of our quantized kernel variants experienced a partial load failure which caused a fallback to a different execution path that changes distance scaling for affected queries.

What we’re doing:
- Routing affected traffic to a warmed fallback pool while we validate a kernel repair.
- Collecting a focused replay of your recent queries to verify corrected similarity distributions.
- Preparing a remediation and regression plan; we expect a validated workaround within 4 hours.

Immediate customer commitments:
- Daily status updates until resolved.
- Root-cause postmortem within 72 hours, with corrective timeline.
- Proactive credit for affected token volume on request.

Proposed next step: 30-minute sync at 13:00 PDT today to review impact and timeline. Does that work?

--- end draft ---

If that looks good I can send it as-is. I left the credit line intentionally non-binding (we can loop sales if needed).

Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Reed <oliver@greenlane.ai>, support@greenlane.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Brief update: service disruption affecting embedding similarity (SEV-2)

Oliver / GreenLane team —

Short executive snapshot from Redwood. I'm Sofia (Director, Customer Reliability). We detected a degradation that is impacting embedding similarity results for a small fraction of queries in your production index. This is a SEV-2 incident: availability is intact but results quality has regressed for queries with long context.

Status (10:05 PDT):
- Scope: ~12% of queries in your nightly batch with >512 tokens show elevated distance values leading to retrieval misses.
- Mitigation in progress: routing affected traffic to our warmed fallback pool (partial mitigation in roll-out; ~60% traffic rerouted so far).
- ETA for validated workaround: ~4 hours (target 14:00 PDT).

Customer commitments from Redwood:
- Hourly status updates until we confirm full remediation.
- A formal postmortem within 72 hours with corrective actions and timelines.
- If your team prefers, we'll issue a credit for affected usage after we quantify impact.

Asks for GreenLane:
- Please confirm if the proposed 30-minute sync at 13:00 PDT works, or propose another slot.
- If you can, please share any high-priority query IDs or examples you want prioritized in the replay.

Attachments: impact matrix with observed anomaly windows.

We’ll stay in close touch — sending hourly updates.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: greenlane_impact_matrix.csv]
From: Oliver Reed <oliver@greenlane.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: support@greenlane.ai
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Brief update: service disruption affecting embedding similarity (SEV-2)

Thanks, Sofia — appreciate the quick update and the transparency. 13:00 PDT works for us.

A couple of asks from our side:
- We'd like the replay results and the sample query list prior to the call (even if preliminary).
- Please include any logs that show the kernel fallback events around 01:00–03:00 PDT; our SREs want to correlate with our ingest windows.

We'd also like an estimate of client-visible rollback options if the workaround does not fully restore expected similarity distributions.

Oliver
VP Engineering, GreenLane AI
